response.sql: WITH site_groups AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage, AVG(ABS(p.proccpu - p.procgpu)) AS avg_cpu_gpu_difference FROM scanprocessing AS p JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_storage) AS mean_group_storage FROM site_groups) SELECT g.site_code, g.insurance_status, g.avg_remaining_storage, g.avg_cpu_gpu_difference, g.avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(o.mean_group_storage, 0) AS storage_ratio FROM site_groups AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_group_storage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: If the mean of group averages is zero, the undefined ratios are returned as NULL.
